narr: A negatively tilted trough and a strong mid-level jet resulted in a severe weather outbreak across the area. Three tornadoes were observed, 1 near Schuyler and 2 more near Douglas in Otoe County. Severe hail and damaging wind gusts were also reported.
ev: Storm chaser reported flash flooding between Pickrell and Adams.
lsr: STORM CHASER REPORTED FLASH FLOODING FROM PICKRELL TO ADAMS.
